question: 已送达且有评分的订单中，准时与延误两组的订单平均评分如何分布？

延误定义.default_basis: 沿用第三组 Report §2.4 自然日主口径；完整时点为敏感性比较。

labels.calendar: 按自然日，当天签收算准时
labels.clock: 按完整时间戳，晚于预计时刻算晚送

checks.orders 的主键完整且唯一: SELECT order_id,count(*) FROM orders GROUP BY order_id HAVING count(*)>1 OR order_id IS NULL
checks.items 的主键完整且唯一: SELECT order_id,order_item_id,count(*) FROM items GROUP BY order_id,order_item_id HAVING count(*)>1 OR order_id IS NULL OR order_item_id IS NULL
checks.payments 的主键完整且唯一: SELECT order_id,payment_sequential,count(*) FROM payments GROUP BY order_id,payment_sequential HAVING count(*)>1 OR order_id IS NULL OR payment_sequential IS NULL
checks.items 每条明细有主单: select rowid,order_id from items where order_id is null or not exists (select 1 from orders o where o.order_id=items.order_id)
checks.payments 每条明细有主单: select rowid,order_id from payments where order_id is null or not exists (select 1 from orders o where o.order_id=payments.order_id)
checks.reviews 每条明细有主单: select rowid,order_id from reviews where order_id is null or not exists (select 1 from orders o where o.order_id=reviews.order_id)

exports.结构.csv: select 'orders' source,count(*) source_rows,count(distinct order_id) orders from orders union all select 'items' source,count(*) source_rows,count(distinct order_id) orders from items union all select 'payments' source,count(*) source_rows,count(distinct order_id) orders from payments union all select 'reviews' source,count(*) source_rows,count(distinct order_id) orders from reviews

done.title: 四张表如何对应一笔订单？
done.body:
共同匹配字段　order_id
目标粒度　一行一单。同一订单在明细表可以出现多次。

tables.sql: select '订单' 来源关系,'一笔订单' 每行代表,count(*) 原表行数,count(distinct order_id) 覆盖订单 from orders union all select '├ 商品' 来源关系,'一条商品明细' 每行代表,count(*) 原表行数,count(distinct order_id) 覆盖订单 from items union all select '├ 支付' 来源关系,'一次支付' 每行代表,count(*) 原表行数,count(distinct order_id) 覆盖订单 from payments union all select '└ 评价' 来源关系,'一条评价' 每行代表,count(*) 原表行数,count(distinct order_id) 覆盖订单 from reviews
select order_id 订单号,count(*) 支付次数 from payments group by order_id having count(*)>1 limit 3

checks.订单主键集合及行数一致: select order_id from orders except select order_id from base
checks.每单至多一行: select order_id from base group by order_id having count(*)!=1
checks.评分在1至5: select rowid,review_score from reviews where review_score is null or review_score not in ('1','2','3','4','5')
checks.item_cents 守恒: select sum(item_cents) from base having sum(item_cents) != (select sum(cast(round(price*100) as integer)) from items)
checks.freight_cents 守恒: select sum(freight_cents) from base having sum(freight_cents) != (select sum(cast(round(freight_value*100) as integer)) from items)
checks.paid_cents 守恒: select sum(paid_cents) from base having sum(paid_cents) != (select sum(cast(round(payment_value*100) as integer)) from payments)

exports.匹配对账.csv: select count(*) orders,sum(item_n is null) no_item,sum(payment_n is null) no_payment,sum(review_n is null) no_review,sum(item_cents) item_cents,sum(freight_cents) freight_cents,sum(paid_cents) paid_cents from base
exports.连接诊断.csv: select b.order_id,b.item_n,b.payment_n,b.paid_cents as verified_cents,sum(cast(round(p.payment_value*100) as integer)) as naive_cents from base b join items i using(order_id) join payments p using(order_id) where b.item_n=2 and b.payment_n=2 group by b.order_id order by b.order_id limit 5

candidates.name: 直接连接商品与支付明细（教学候选）
sql: create table it as select order_id,count(*) item_n,sum(cast(round(price*100) as integer)) item_cents,sum(cast(round(freight_value*100) as integer)) freight_cents from items group by order_id
create table pay as select order_id,count(*) payment_n,sum(cast(round(payment_value*100) as integer)) paid_cents from payments group by order_id
create table rev as select order_id,count(*) review_n,avg(cast(review_score as integer)) score from reviews group by order_id

create table base as select o.*,item_n,item_cents,freight_cents,payment_n,paid_cents,review_n,score from orders o left join items using(order_id) left join payments using(order_id) left join it using(order_id) left join pay using(order_id) left join rev using(order_id)

candidates.name: 分别汇总明细后连接
sql: create table it as select order_id,count(*) item_n,sum(cast(round(price*100) as integer)) item_cents,sum(cast(round(freight_value*100) as integer)) freight_cents from items group by order_id
create table pay as select order_id,count(*) payment_n,sum(cast(round(payment_value*100) as integer)) paid_cents from payments group by order_id
create table rev as select order_id,count(*) review_n,avg(cast(review_score as integer)) score from reviews group by order_id

create table base as select o.*,item_n,item_cents,freight_cents,payment_n,paid_cents,review_n,score from orders o left join it using(order_id) left join pay using(order_id) left join rev using(order_id)

rejected.title: × 合并失败 · 一笔订单被展开
rejected.body: 两件商品分别匹配两次支付。按 E 检查同一笔支付出现在哪两行。

tables.sql: with chosen as (select order_id from base where item_n=2 and payment_n=2 group by order_id having count(*)>1 order by order_id limit 1), pairs as (select i.order_id,i.order_item_id item,p.payment_sequential seq,p.payment_value amount from chosen join items i using(order_id) join payments p using(order_id)) select order_id 触发问题的订单,count(*) 连接行数,(select round(paid_cents/100.0,2) from pay where order_id=pairs.order_id) 原支付额,round(sum(amount),2) 展开后合计 from pairs group by order_id

with chosen as (select order_id from base where item_n=2 and payment_n=2 group by order_id having count(*)>1 order by order_id limit 1), pairs as (select i.order_id,i.order_item_id item,p.payment_sequential seq,p.payment_value amount from chosen join items i using(order_id) join payments p using(order_id)) select item 商品序号,seq 支付序号,amount 支付金额 from pairs order by item,seq

done.title: ✓ 先汇总，再连接
done.body: 分别将商品、支付、评价汇总到订单粒度，再与订单主表左连接。

tables.sql: select count(*) 合并行数,count(distinct order_id) 不同订单数,sum(paid_cents)-(select sum(cast(round(payment_value*100) as integer)) from payments) 支付差额_分 from base

stages.name: 3 质量标记
sql: create table quality as select *,case when order_status is null then 'status_unknown' when order_status!='delivered' then 'outside_delivered' when order_delivered_customer_date is null then 'missing_actual' when julianday(order_delivered_customer_date)<julianday(order_purchase_timestamp) then 'negative_duration' when order_purchase_timestamp is null or order_estimated_delivery_date is null then 'missing_reference' else 'eligible' end quality from base

checks.order_purchase_timestamp 时间可解析: select order_id,order_purchase_timestamp from base where order_purchase_timestamp is not null and julianday(order_purchase_timestamp) is null
checks.order_delivered_customer_date 时间可解析: select order_id,order_delivered_customer_date from base where order_delivered_customer_date is not null and julianday(order_delivered_customer_date) is null
checks.order_estimated_delivery_date 时间可解析: select order_id,order_estimated_delivery_date from base where order_estimated_delivery_date is not null and julianday(order_estimated_delivery_date) is null

exports.质量处置.csv: select quality,count(*) n,min(order_id) example from quality group by quality

done.title: 缺少签收时间，影响哪些指标？
done.body: 已送达却缺签收的记录保留在全表，计算履约时长时排除。

tables.sql: select case when order_status='delivered' then '已送达' else '其他状态' end 状态,count(*) 订单数,sum(order_delivered_customer_date is null) 缺签收 from quality group by 1
select order_id 订单号,order_status 状态,order_delivered_customer_date 签收 from quality where quality='missing_actual' limit 3

stages.name: 4 构造变量与样本
sql: create table candidates as select *,julianday(order_delivered_customer_date)-julianday(order_purchase_timestamp) delivery_days,date(order_delivered_customer_date)>date(order_estimated_delivery_date) late_day,order_delivered_customer_date>order_estimated_delivery_date late_clock,quality='eligible' and score is not null rated from quality

exports.口径比较.csv: select sum(rated) denominator,sum(late_day) late_day_n,sum(late_clock) late_clock_n,sum(late_day!=late_clock) switched,min(case when late_day!=late_clock then order_id end) example from candidates where rated
exports.样本筛选.csv: select count(*) all_orders,sum(order_status='delivered') delivered,sum(quality='eligible') fulfillment,sum(rated) rated from candidates

done.title: 哪些订单可以比较评分？
done.body: 每行沿用上一步保留的订单。按 E 查看同一天签收的边界单。

tables.sql: with n as (select count(*) a,sum(order_status='delivered') b,sum(quality='eligible') c,sum(rated) d from candidates) select '① 所有订单' 筛选步骤,a 保留订单,0 本步排除 from n union all select '  ② 已送达',b,a-b from n union all select '    ③ 可计算履约',c,b-c from n union all select '      ④ 有评分',d,c-d from n
select order_id 订单号,order_estimated_delivery_date 预计,order_delivered_customer_date 签收 from candidates where rated and late_day!=late_clock order by order_id limit 1

stages.name: 5 描述统计与探索
sql: create table analysis as select c.*,case when rated then case value when 'calendar' then late_day else late_clock end end late from candidates c cross join decision
create table eda as select late,count(*) n,avg(score) mean_score,sum(score<=2) low_score_n,sum(score>=4) high_score_n from analysis where rated group by late

create table post as select r.order_id,avg(cast(review_score as real)) post_score from reviews r join orders o using(order_id) where julianday(review_answer_timestamp)>=julianday(order_delivered_customer_date) group by r.order_id

create table branches as select 'A' branch,order_id,late,score from analysis where rated union all select 'B',a.order_id,late,score from analysis a join post using(order_id) where rated union all select 'C',a.order_id,late,post_score from analysis a join post using(order_id) where rated

checks.两组分母覆盖分析样本: select sum(n) from eda having sum(n)!=(select sum(rated) from analysis) or (select count(*) from analysis where rated and late is null)>0

exports.分析数据.csv.gz: select * from analysis order by order_id
exports.图表底表.csv: select * from eda order by late
exports.评分分布.csv: select late,score,count(*) n from analysis where rated group by late,score order by late,score
exports.边界记录.csv: select order_id,order_delivered_customer_date,order_estimated_delivery_date,late_day,late_clock,score,late from analysis where rated and late_day!=late_clock order by order_id limit 3
exports.探索对照.csv: select branch,late,count(*) n,avg(score) mean_score from branches group by branch,late order by branch,late

done.title: 差距缩小，变的是样本还是评分？
done.body: A 与 C 同时改变了订单范围和评分定义。下一屏固定 B、C 的订单集合。

tables.sql: with g as (select branch,sum(late=0) ontime,sum(late=1) late_n,avg(case when late=0 then score end)-avg(case when late=1 then score end) gap from branches group by branch) select case branch when 'A' then 'A 全部订单评分样本' when 'B' then 'B 固定送达后有评价样本' else 'C 同样本仅取送达后评分' end 比较,ontime 准时订单,late_n 晚送订单,round(gap,3) 均分差,substr('████████████████████████████████████████',1,round(abs(gap)*8)) 差距 from g where branch in ('A','C') order by branch

done.title: 固定样本后，评分口径改变了多少？
done.body: 先沿 A → B 看筛选样本的变化，再沿 B → C 看同批订单换评分的变化。

tables.sql: with g as (select branch,sum(late=0) ontime,sum(late=1) late_n,avg(case when late=0 then score end)-avg(case when late=1 then score end) gap from branches group by branch) select case branch when 'A' then 'A 全部订单评分样本' when 'B' then 'B 固定送达后有评价样本' else 'C 同样本仅取送达后评分' end 比较,ontime 准时订单,late_n 晚送订单,round(gap,3) 均分差,substr('████████████████████████████████████████',1,round(abs(gap)*8)) 差距 from g where branch in ('A','B','C') order by branch
select count(*) as B与C成员不一致订单数 from (select order_id from branches where branch in ('B','C') group by order_id having count(distinct branch)!=2)
